title: head_mismatch
description: The run would be merge-ready, but its head is not the branch's head on origin or in the worktree, so its green proves nothing. Expected after rebased_behind. Replay-prone. Written by: pipeline-watch.sh (actor watcher). Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

run_id.description: The pipeline run. The watcher always sets it.

branch.description: The run's branch. The watcher always sets it (the issue comes from its issue-<N>).

head.description: The run's head sha (head_sha), null when unreadable.

note.description: Legacy machine-read note: the three heads compared (worktree= only when the branch is checked out). Read by the factory loop (shown as the run's detail). Frozen until it moves into a payload (docs/events.md, Legacy notes).
